lines.en: label beachvacation13:
I feel a light tapping on my shoulder. Like someone is trying to wake me up but is a little worried about doing so.
lines.zh: 我感觉到有人轻轻拍我的肩膀。像是有人想叫醒我，却又有点不敢。

lines.en: : Can we...talk for a little while?...
lines.zh: : 我们……能聊一会儿吗？……

lines.en: scene rinintheinn1

lines.zh: : ……Rin？

lines.en: : I’m sorry to wake you up...
lines.zh: : 抱歉把你吵醒了……

lines.en: : I just...wanted to come see you for a little while...
lines.zh: : 我只是……想过来看看你，待一会儿……

lines.en: scene rinintheinn2
I come to my senses to find a teary-eyed Rin near the side of the bed, nervously tugging on the sheets and glancing around the room.
lines.zh: 我回过神来，发现Rin眼含泪水站在床边，紧张地拽着床单，眼神在房间里四处游移。

lines.en: : Is something going on?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗？

lines.en: scene rinintheinn3
: Maybe...
lines.zh: : 也许吧……

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : I mean, technically, nothing has happened yet.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，严格来说，什么都没发生。

lines.en: : But a thing might happen and I’m nervous and I’m panicking and I kind of just wandered in here hoping you’d be around.
lines.zh: : 可某件事可能会发生，我很紧张，很慌，就那么迷迷糊糊走进来了，希望你会在这儿。

lines.en: : Well I’m definitely around.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我确实在这儿。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn2
: Yeah. You are.
lines.zh: : 是啊。你在。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn3
: So uhh...did you hear that me and Chika are hanging out tonight?
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……你听说我和Chika今晚要一起玩了吗？

lines.en: : I did. And I’m imagining that’s a big part of why you’re on the verge of tears.
lines.zh: : 听说了。而且我猜这就是你快要哭出来的很大一部分原因。

lines.en: : Are you thinking of telling her?
lines.zh: : 你在考虑跟她告白？

lines.en: scene rinintheinn4
: Thinking...yeah. Actually doing it is a whole other thing.
lines.zh: : 考虑……是啊。真要做起来又是另一回事了。

lines.en: : I don’t want it to seem like I’m just getting swept up in the momentum of vacation and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我不想让它看起来像是被度假的气氛一带就冲动了。

lines.en: : And I’ve never confessed to anyone before so I don’t even know what I would do.
lines.zh: : 而且我从来没跟人告白过，所以连该怎么做都不知道。

lines.en: : Isn’t it as simple as just...telling her how you feel?
lines.zh: : 不就是……把你的感受告诉她吗？

lines.en: : I’m not really the best when it comes to any sort of feelings, so sorry if it’s more complicated than that.
lines.zh: : 涉及感情的事我其实一点也不在行，所以如果比这更复杂的话，抱歉。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn3
: It’s definitely more complicated than that...
lines.zh: : 确实比这复杂得多……

lines.en: : Especially considering that we’re both girls.
lines.zh: : 尤其是考虑到我们两个都是女生。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn6
: Chika’s popular and...even if in some crazy reality she were to accept my confession, doing that would probably make a lot of her friends look at her differently.
lines.zh: : Chika很受欢迎，而且……就算在某个疯狂的现实里她接受了我的告白，那也可能会让她很多朋友用不一样的眼光看她。

lines.en: Has Rin already decided that she’s going to be rejected?...
lines.zh: Rin已经认定自己会被拒绝了吗？……

lines.en: : What’s this about a ‘crazy reality?’ You’re making it sound like you’ve already given up.
lines.zh: : 「疯狂的现实」是什么意思？你说的像是早就放弃了。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn7
: There’s a big difference between giving up and accepting how things are.
lines.zh: : 放弃和接受现实，这两者可大不一样。

lines.en: : When she and I were talking last night...I figured out that there’s basically no chance of this working out in my favor.
lines.zh: : 昨晚我和她聊天的时候……我弄明白了一件事：这事儿基本上不可能朝对我有利的方向发展。

lines.en: : She definitely has feelings for somebody. But it’s a million-percent not me.
lines.zh: : 她肯定对某个人有感情。但那个人百分之一百万不是我。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn9
: Do you know who it {i}is{/i}, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你知道那个人{i}是{/i}谁吗？

lines.en: : Because I’m pretty sure I do.
lines.zh: : 因为我觉得自己知道。

lines.en: : And I've gotta say, it's pretty surprising to me.
lines.zh: : 而且我得说，这让我挺意外的。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn8
: But it’s fine...We can’t help who we fall in love with.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系……我们没法控制自己爱上谁。

lines.en: : I mean, maybe I’m supposed to be rejected?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，也许我注定要被拒绝？

lines.en: : Maybe that’s just...what needs to happen in order for me to move on?
lines.zh: : 也许那只是……我往前走所必须经历的事？

lines.en: : What do you think, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你怎么想，Sensei？

lines.en: : We’re good friends now...
lines.zh: : 我们现在是好朋友了……

lines.en: : Tell me how you feel.
lines.zh: : 告诉我你的想法。

lines.en: : Why does how I feel matter at all?
lines.zh: : 我的想法为什么重要？

lines.en: : Why wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 为什么不重要？

lines.en: : Because this isn’t about me.
lines.zh: : 因为这不是我的事。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn7
: Heh...Yeah.
lines.zh: : 呵……是啊。

lines.en: : You’re right.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。

lines.en: : You’ve helped me enough as is. I shouldn’t be pushing any more problems onto you.
lines.zh: : 你已经帮我够多了。我不该再把更多问题推给你。

lines.en: : It’s not fair.
lines.zh: : 这不公平。

lines.en: {i}Not fair.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不公平。{/i}

lines.en: What is fair, exactly?
lines.zh: 所谓公平，到底是什么？

lines.en: And what's all of this about pushing her problems onto me?
lines.zh: 还有「把问题推给我」又是从哪儿说起的？

lines.en: If anything, Rin has been keeping her problems {i}away{/i} from me.
lines.zh: 要说的话，Rin一直在把问题{i}藏起来{/i}不让我知道。

lines.en: : Is that why you didn’t tell me you started hurting yourself again? You're afraid of getting me more involved?
lines.zh: : 这就是你不告诉我你又开始伤害自己的原因吗？你怕把我牵扯得更深？

lines.en: scene rinintheinn10
: Huh?
: What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 你在说什么？

lines.en: : One of your friends recently opened up to me about how worried they are about you.
lines.zh: : 你的一个朋友最近跟我坦白说，她很担心你。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : She saw your arm.
lines.zh: : 她看到了你的手臂。

lines.en: : When would anyone have even-
lines.zh: : 什么时候有人——

lines.en: scene rinintheinn11
: It was Molly, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是Molly，对吧？

lines.en: : You really think I’d tell you-
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我会告——

lines.en: scene rinintheinn12
: Definitely Molly.
lines.zh: : 肯定是Molly。

lines.en: : Listen...it isn’t what it sounds like.
lines.zh: : 听着……事情不是听起来那样。

lines.en: : I promise that I haven’t done anything like that since you caught me.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，自从被你抓到那次之后，我就再没做过那种事了。

lines.en: : She probably just saw some of my old scars since I didn’t put any concealer on them that day.
lines.zh: : 她大概只是看到了一些旧疤，因为那天我没在上面涂遮瑕。

lines.en: : Do you want to check? There’s nothing there. I promise.
lines.zh: : 你要检查吗？什么都没有。我保证。

lines.en: : ...It’s fine.
lines.zh: : ……不用了。

lines.en: : I don’t need to check.
lines.zh: : 我不需要检查。

lines.en: : I’m supposed to trust you.
lines.zh: : 我应该相信你。

lines.en: : Mhm...And I’m supposed to trust you too.
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯……那我也应该相信你。

lines.en: : Do you mind if I sit on the bed?
lines.zh: : 我可以坐到床上吗？

lines.en: : I’m starting to feel this weird power dynamic just kneeling at your side.
lines.zh: : 就那么跪在你旁边，我开始有种奇怪的压迫感。

lines.en: : Of course...
lines.zh: : 当然……

lines.en: scene black
Rin pulls herself off of the ground and moves closer to me.
lines.zh: Rin从地上撑起身，朝我靠近了些。

lines.en: The two of us back against the headboard, but she doesn’t look at me for some reason.
lines.zh: 我们两个靠在床头，可不知为什么她不看我。

lines.en: She’s not normally the type to stray from eye contact when she isn’t in depression-mode, so it makes me a little uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 她平时不是那种在没陷入抑郁状态时会回避眼神接触的人，所以这让我有点不自在。

lines.en: But I suck it up and deal with it for the time being.
lines.zh: 不过我忍下来，暂时不去管它。

lines.en: This is her time to vent.
lines.zh: 现在是她倾诉的时间。

lines.en: And I told her I’d be there for her if anything like that happened over the weekend.
lines.zh: 而且我跟她说过，这个周末要是发生这种事，我会陪着她。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn13
: You’re not wearing a shirt.
lines.zh: : 你没穿上衣。

lines.en: : Are you just now realizing this?
lines.zh: : 你现在才注意到？

lines.en: : I was a little distracted by my own feelings before, but now that we’re on the bed together I’ve become increasingly aware of it.
lines.zh: : 之前我被自己的情绪分了神，不过现在我们两个一起躺在床上，我就越来越在意了。

lines.en: : Should I put one on?
lines.zh: : 要我穿一件吗？

lines.en: : Nah...It’s okay.
lines.zh: : 不用……没关系。

lines.en: : Everyone else is doing stuff right now anyway. No one will see us and get the wrong idea or anything.
lines.zh: : 反正其他人现在都在忙。不会有人看到我们然后误会什么的。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn14
: So do you...have any advice for a girl on her deathbed?
lines.zh: : 那么，你有什么建议能给一个躺在死亡之床上的女生吗？

lines.en: : You’re not on your deathbed, Rin.
lines.zh: : 你又不是躺在死亡之床上，Rin。

lines.en: : Mental death bed.
lines.zh: : 精神上的死亡之床。

lines.en: : I’m probably gonna...shut down for a little bit after tonight.
lines.zh: : 今晚之后我大概会……关机一会儿。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’ll be able to prevent it even with you there.
lines.zh: : 就算有你在，我觉得自己也阻止不了。

lines.en: : But what if in that “crazy reality” of yours, Chika says yes to you?
lines.zh: : 可万一在你那个「疯狂的现实」里，Chika答应你了呢？

lines.en: scene rinintheinn15
: Then I’d shut down out of joy. It would be a horrible first impression as a girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 那我会开心到死机。作为女朋友，那可是糟糕透顶的第一印象。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think that would be a turn-off for me too.
lines.zh: : 是啊，换我我也会扫兴的。

lines.en: : Really? So you don’t think I’m girlfriend material, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？所以你觉得我当不了女朋友，Sensei？

lines.en: : Well...I never said that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我可没那么说。

lines.en: : What am I then? The mistress? The friend with benefits?
lines.zh: : 那我算什么？情妇？炮友？

lines.en: : I haven’t even received any benefits yet.
lines.zh: : 我连一点好处都还没拿到呢。

lines.en: : What are you talking about? I showed you my boobs once, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 你在说什么啊？我不是给你看过一次胸吗？

lines.en: : Not calling them a benefit is pretty rude.
lines.zh: : 不把它当成好处，可是相当失礼哦。

lines.en: : Well it's not like you showed me them under the best conditions.
lines.zh: : 嗯，可你给我看的时候条件也不怎么好啊。

lines.en: : Wanna see them again now?
lines.zh: : 那现在想再看一次吗？

lines.en: : These aren’t really the best conditions either.
lines.zh: : 现在这条件也不怎么样。

lines.en: : I will patiently await the day that you flash me without tears in your eyes.
lines.zh: : 我会耐心等那一天——你眼里没有眼泪的时候再给我看。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn16
: Hahahah! This is exactly why you and I have gotten so close.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！我们俩能变得这么亲近，就是因为这一点。

lines.en: : But there’s one thing that confuses me about all of it.
lines.zh: : 不过有一件事我很困惑。

lines.en: : And what’s that?
lines.zh: : 什么事？

lines.en: scene rinintheinn17
: You’ve had plenty of opportunities to push me into being more than just a buddy, but you’ve never really taken advantage of any of them.
lines.zh: : 你有的是机会把我推到「不只是哥们」的位置上，可你从来没有真的利用过任何一个。

lines.en: : Is that really because you’re trying to protect me? Or is it something else?
lines.zh: : 那真的是因为你想保护我吗？还是别的原因？

lines.en: : What else would it be?
lines.zh: : 还能是什么原因？

lines.en: : Don't know. Maybe you don’t think I’m pretty.
lines.zh: : 不知道。也许你觉得我不够漂亮。

lines.en: : Or maybe I'm just too damaged or something like that.
lines.zh: : 或者也许我太破败了之类的。

lines.en: : Are you asking me to try and push things further?
lines.zh: : 你是在要求我把关系推得更进一步吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely not. I’m thankful that you’ve been the way you’ve been. It’s just a little weird when I think about some of the stuff you say.
lines.zh: : 绝对不是。我很感激你一直是这个样子。只是想起你说过的一些话，会觉得有点怪。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn18
: You’re kind of a pervert, aren’t you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你有点变态对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : Why would you willingly climb into bed with me if you think that?
lines.zh: : 既然你这么想，为什么还主动爬上我的床？

lines.en: : Because of my anti-pervert barrier. You won’t touch me as long as I’m crying.
lines.zh: : 因为我有反变态屏障。只要我在哭，你就不会碰我。

lines.en: : Which is exactly why I want you to let me sleep here tonight.
lines.zh: : 所以这正是我今晚想睡在这儿的原因。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: scene rinintheinn19
: You really think I’ll be able to sleep in the same room as Chika immediately after she rejects me?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我被Chika拒绝之后，还能立刻跟她睡在同一个房间里？

lines.en: : Come on. You know me better than that.
lines.zh: : 拜托。你比我更了解我吧。

lines.en: : I want to sleep next to you.
lines.zh: : 我想睡在你旁边。

lines.en: : And I want you to rub my head and tell me everything will be okay.
lines.zh: : 我想让你摸我的头，告诉我一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: : And I want to pass out knowing that someone is there to protect me.
lines.zh: : 我想在知道有人在保护我的情况下睡过去。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn13
: And also...I won’t really be able to do anything stupid as long as you’re here with me.
lines.zh: : 还有……只要你在，我就做不出什么蠢事。

lines.en: : So if I try to get up or something, just squeeze me really tight and don’t let me go.
lines.zh: : 所以我要是想起身什么的，你就把我紧紧抱住，别让我走。

lines.en: : You’re giving your shirtless teacher permission to squeeze you and not let you leave the bed in the middle of the night?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你允许一个光着上身的老师在半夜把你抱紧，不让你下床？

lines.en: : That is correct.
lines.zh: : 正是如此。

lines.en: : And you’re calling {i}me{/i} the pervert?
lines.zh: : 而你管{i}我{/i}叫变态？

lines.en: scene rinintheinn20
: Is there a problem with that?
lines.zh: : 这有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : Not really. Just pointing out the flaws in your logic.
lines.zh: : 没有。只是指出你逻辑上的漏洞罢了。

lines.en: : Logic doesn’t apply to a maiden in love.
lines.zh: : 逻辑对恋爱中的少女不适用。

lines.en: : My mind is Chika and nothing but Chika.
lines.zh: : 我心里全是Chika，除了Chika什么都没有。

lines.en: : And some really depressing stuff, too, I guess. But mostly Chika.
lines.zh: : 大概还有些很丧的东西吧。不过主要是Chika。

lines.en: A moment of silence passes by as Rin makes more room in her mind for unrequited love.
lines.zh: 一阵沉默，Rin在心里为这份无果的爱腾出了更多空间。

lines.en: There’s no telling how the night will go for her, but if it’s anything like I expect it to be, I’m not sure if tragedy is enough to even describe it.
lines.zh: 谁也说不准今晚对她而言会怎样，不过要是跟我预料的差不多，我甚至不确定「悲剧」这个词够不够形容。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn21
: Do you think I’m just being impulsive right now? In regard to confessing, I mean.
lines.zh: : 你觉得我现在只是冲动吗？我是说，告白这件事。

lines.en: : Should I maybe...wait a little longer?
lines.zh: : 我要不要……再等等看？

lines.en: : {i}Can{/i} you wait a little longer?
lines.zh: : 你{i}等得了吗{/i}？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Probably not.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。大概等不了。

lines.en: : I can barely even look at her, dude. And each time our eyes meet I just instantly go red.
lines.zh: : 我连看她都不敢看，哥们。每次我们的目光一碰上，我立刻就脸红。

lines.en: : I keep thinking to myself, “There’s no way she doesn’t notice.”
lines.zh: : 我一直在心里想，「她不可能没注意到吧」。

lines.en: if chikadorm20 == True:
: But then she goes and accuses me of liking {i}you{/i} and I’m just like...how would she even get that idea?
lines.zh: : 可结果她反倒指责我喜欢{i}你{/i}，我就觉得……她到底是怎么想出来的？

lines.en: : I don’t like the way you said ‘you’ there, but I get it.
lines.zh: : 你刚才那个「你」字我听着不太舒服，不过我懂你的意思。

lines.en: else:
: But then she goes and asks if {i}Molly{/i} is the one I’m into.
lines.zh: : 然后她还问我喜欢的人是不是{i}Molly{/i}。

lines.en: : You mean, {i}Molly{/i} Molly?
lines.zh: : 你是说，{i}Molly{/i}那个Molly？

lines.en: : Yes. {i}Molly{/i} Molly.
lines.zh: : 对。就是那个{i}Molly{/i}。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn22
: Girls are dumb. I don’t know how you put up with us all the time.
lines.zh: : 女生真蠢。真不知道你怎么受得了天天跟我们混在一起。

lines.en: : It definitely helps that you’re all cute.
lines.zh: : 你们都很可爱，这确实帮了大忙。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn23
: Can I be really real for a second?
lines.zh: : 我能说句真心话吗？

lines.en: : Of course. But like I said, if you’re going to flash me, please wait until you’re not crying anymore.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过就像我说的，你要是想给我看胸，请等你不再哭了之后。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn24
: I’m not gonna flash you, idiot.
lines.zh: : 我才不会给你看呢，笨蛋。

lines.en: : I just want to know...
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道……

lines.en: scene rinintheinn23

lines.zh: : 如果……

lines.en: : If there’s anything...going on between you and Chika.
lines.zh: : 如果你和Chika之间……有什么的话。

lines.en: if chikadorm20 == True:
I knew this question was coming.
lines.zh: 我就知道她会问这个。

lines.en: In fact, I’m guessing that was probably the reason for this entire visit.
lines.zh: 事实上，我猜这大概就是她这趟来的真正原因。

lines.en: I’m not sure how the conversation between those two went last night, but Chika clearly gave Rin the idea that something was happening between us.
lines.zh: 我不确定她们俩昨晚的对话是怎样的，但Chika显然给Rin留下了我们之间有点什么的印象。

lines.en: And frankly, it’s not her fault.
lines.zh: 而且老实说，这不怪她。

lines.en: It’s my fault for doing exactly what Rin didn’t want me to do.
lines.zh: 是我的错，因为我恰恰做了Rin不希望我做的事。

lines.en: I pursued a relationship with the girl she claims to love.
lines.zh: 我追求了她声称爱着的那个女孩。

lines.en: And I did it all while calling the one sitting next me, the one doing her absolute best to hold back her tears-
lines.zh: 而我做这一切的时候，还管坐在我身边的这个人——这个拼尽全力忍住眼泪的人——

lines.en: A friend.
lines.zh: 叫朋友。

lines.en: : Tell me the truth...
lines.zh: : 告诉我实话……

lines.en: : I’ve seen the way you look at her.
lines.zh: : 我看过你看她的眼神。

lines.en: : I've seen how she looks at you.
lines.zh: : 我也看过她看你的眼神。

lines.en: : How...
lines.zh: : 到底……

lines.en: : How far has it gone?
lines.zh: : 到底进展到什么地步了？

lines.en: scene rinintheinn25
: Have you kissed her, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 你亲过她了吗，Sensei？……

lines.en: : Have you...put your fingers inside of her?...
lines.zh: : 你……用手指插进去过了吗？……

lines.en: : Did she suck your dick?...
lines.zh: : 她给你口交了吗？……

lines.en: : How far has it gone?...
lines.zh: : 到底进展到什么地步了？……

lines.en: : And why haven’t you told me about it?
lines.zh: : 还有为什么你一直没告诉我？

lines.en: : We’re supposed to be friends.
lines.zh: : 我们应该是朋友啊。

lines.en: : You’re supposed to tell me things.
lines.zh: : 你本该把这些事告诉我的。

lines.en: : Just like I’ve told you everything about me.
lines.zh: : 就像我把关于我的一切都告诉了你一样。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn26
: But...you went and did this...
lines.zh: : 可是……你却去做了这种事……

lines.en: : And now you’re not even saying anything...
lines.zh: : 而现在你连话都不说……

lines.en: : I won’t get mad...I just want to hear it from you.
lines.zh: : 我不会生气的……我只是想亲耳听你说。

lines.en: : I want to know what’s making her smile so brightly when it’s clearly not me.
lines.zh: : 我想知道，明明不是我，是什么让她笑得那么灿烂。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn27
: At least...give me that...
lines.zh: : 至少……告诉我这个……

lines.en: I can’t hide the truth from her any longer.
lines.zh: 我不能再对她隐瞒真相了。

lines.en: Rin deserves to know what’s been happening.
lines.zh: Rin有权知道发生了什么。

lines.en: That way, she can confess with a clear conscience.
lines.zh: 这样，她才能问心无愧地去告白。

lines.en: If she even wants to confess after hearing it straight from my mouth.
lines.zh: 如果亲耳听我说完之后，她还想告白的话。

lines.en: : We’ve...done some things...
lines.zh: : 我们……做过一些事……

lines.en: scene rinintheinn28
: What kind of things, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 什么样的事，Sensei？……

lines.en: : Things you’re embarrassed to talk about?
lines.zh: : 是你不好意思说出口的事？

lines.en: : Things I don’t think you need to hear.
lines.zh: : 是我觉得你不需要知道的事。

lines.en: : Even though I’ll never be able to do them with her?
lines.zh: : 就算我永远都没机会跟她做那些事？

lines.en: : ...You don’t know that.
lines.zh: : ……这你可说不准。

lines.en: : Of course I do...she loves you...
lines.zh: : 我当然说得准……她爱你……

lines.en: : And whatever you’re doing seems to be working based on how excited she gets whenever you come up...
lines.zh: : 而且不管你做了什么，从每次提起你她就那么兴奋来看，显然很有效……

lines.en: scene rinintheinn29
: How pretty was she when you touched her?...
lines.zh: : 你碰她的时候，她有多漂亮？……

lines.en: : What was she wearing?
lines.zh: : 她当时穿的什么？

lines.en: scene rinintheinn30
: I...I want...
: I want to know...
lines.zh: : 我想知道……

lines.en: scene rinintheinn31
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : It hurts.
lines.zh: : 好痛。

lines.en: : It hurts so bad.
lines.zh: : 痛得不行。

lines.en: : I know it does.
lines.zh: : 我知道很痛。

lines.en: : But it will go away.
lines.zh: : 但这会过去的。

lines.en: : Will it?
lines.zh: : 会吗？

lines.en: : It will.
lines.zh: : 会的。

lines.en: : I...still...trust you...
lines.zh: : 我……还是……相信你……

lines.en: : Even though you...
lines.zh: : 就算你……

lines.en: : Please...just...hold me for a little while...
lines.zh: : 求你……就……抱我一会儿……

lines.en: : I need to...feel something...
lines.zh: : 我需要……感觉到什么……

lines.en: scene rinintheinn32
With no words, I pull Rin closer to me and she instantly breaks into tears.
lines.zh: 我什么也没说，把Rin拉近，她立刻就哭了出来。

lines.en: Before the end of the day, this girl will likely experience heartbreak a second time.
lines.zh: 在今天结束之前，这丫头大概会第二次心碎。

lines.en: The first was at the hands of me.
lines.zh: 第一次是拜我所赐。

lines.en: A man who broke the one and only promise she ever asked him to make.
lines.zh: 一个打破了她唯一求他许下的承诺的男人。

lines.en: And the second will be at the hands of the opposite end of that promise.
lines.zh: 而第二次，将来自那个承诺的另一端。

lines.en: The world is filled with horrible things-
lines.zh: 这世上充满了可怕的东西——

lines.en: And I am among them.
lines.zh: 而我就是其中之一。

lines.en: But this is something I’ve known all along.
lines.zh: 不过这一点我一直都知道。

lines.en: What more are relationships than tools to use to your advantage?
lines.zh: 所谓关系，除了用来为自己谋利的工具，又是什么呢？

lines.en: Rin knows this.
lines.zh: Rin明白这一点。

lines.en: She has to.
lines.zh: 她必须明白。

lines.en: It’s why she doesn’t blame me for fingering the girl she loves.
lines.zh: 所以她才不怪我用手指插了她爱的女孩。

lines.en: It’s why she needs {i}my{/i} shoulder to cry on right now.
lines.zh: 所以她现在才需要一个肩膀来哭。

lines.en: Because we’re all dependent on one another.
lines.zh: 因为我们都彼此依赖。

lines.en: Just some for different reasons than others.
lines.zh: 只是各自依赖的理由不同罢了。

lines.en: And that’s not to say I’m not sorry.
lines.zh: 这并不是说我不觉得抱歉。

lines.en: I am.
lines.zh: 我很抱歉。

lines.en: I never wanted her to cry like this.
lines.zh: 我从来没想过要让她哭成这样。

lines.en: But at the same time-
lines.zh: 但与此同时——

lines.en: I was never going to reject Chika.
lines.zh: 我也从来没打算拒绝Chika。

lines.en: I only said I would.
lines.zh: 我只是嘴上说过会拒绝而已。

lines.en: scene black
We can’t help who we fall in love with.
lines.zh: 我们没法控制自己爱上谁。

lines.en: But we can help falling in love.
lines.zh: 但我们能控制自己不去爱上谁。

lines.en: And love is such a confusing word.
lines.zh: 而「爱」这个词又如此令人困惑。

lines.en: The worst word that doesn’t begin with the letter T.
lines.zh: 是除了 T 开头之外最糟的那个词。

lines.en: {i}A heart snapped like a twig and crushed underfoot.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}一颗心像枯枝一样被折断，又被踩在脚下。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Directly above the place where dreams become reality.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}就在梦想成真之地的正上方。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Where all sins are forgiven. Where all bonds are temporary.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在那里，一切罪孽都被宽恕。在那里，一切羁绊都只是暂时的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Thus is the fleeting life we live.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}这就是我们转瞬即逝的人生。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Everything will be over before we know it.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}一切都会在我们察觉之前结束。{/i}

lines.en: {i}So we have no time to sit idly by and wait for others to make their move.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}所以我们没有时间坐等着别人先出招。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Seize the day. Throw yourself into the wishing well.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}把握当下。把自己投进许愿井里。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And before you forget-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而在你忘记之前——{/i}

lines.en: {i}Make your dreams come true.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}去实现你的梦想吧。{/i}

: You...really didn’t do anything?
lines.zh: : 你……真的什么都没做？

lines.en: if chikatownfirst == True:
Well...the truth is we did kiss.
lines.zh: 嗯……事实上我们确实亲过。

lines.en: But Rin doesn’t need to know that.
lines.zh: 不过Rin不需要知道这个。

lines.en: It was nothing.
lines.zh: 那不算什么。

lines.en: Just two people caught up in the moment.
lines.zh: 只是两个被气氛冲昏头的人而已。

lines.en: If I was truly malicious, I could have taken things further.
lines.zh: 要是我真那么恶毒，我本可以把事情推得更远。

lines.en: But I didn’t.
lines.zh: 但我没有。

lines.en: So not telling her is fine.
lines.zh: 所以不告诉她也没关系。

lines.en: : I really didn’t...
lines.zh: : 我真的没有……

: I really didn’t...
lines.zh: : 我真的没有……

lines.zh: : 可是……等等。

lines.en: : I don’t get it. Why does she seem so into you then?
lines.zh: : 我不明白。那她为什么看起来对你那么上心？

lines.en: : You’ve at least been spending time together, right?
lines.zh: : 你们至少经常在一起吧？

lines.en: : Of course we have. Chika’s a friend of mine, just like you are.
lines.zh: : 当然。Chika是我的朋友，就像你一样。

lines.en: : And you and I haven’t done anything, have we?
lines.zh: : 而你和我没做过什么，对吧？

lines.en: scene rinintheinn34
: Somehow or another, no. We haven’t done anything.
lines.zh: : 不知怎么的，对，我们什么都没做。

lines.en: : It’s because you cry too much.
lines.zh: : 因为你太爱哭了。

lines.en: : And also how I think penises are kind of weird.
lines.zh: : 还有因为我觉得鸡巴这种东西有点怪。

lines.en: : Well I think you’re kind of weird.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我还觉得你有点怪呢。

lines.en: : Yeah but the difference is you still hang out with me, and when I come to see you, I’m not coming to see your penis.
lines.zh: : 是，但区别在于你还是愿意跟我混在一起，而且我来看你的时候，可不是来看你的鸡巴。

lines.en: : Well, how would I know that? You could have strange motives.
lines.zh: : 那我怎么知道？说不定你动机不纯。

lines.en: : You’re right. The whole bisexual thing is just a front.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。双性恋那套全是伪装。

lines.en: : I actually don’t like girls at all. It’s all just one big ploy to see your dick.
lines.zh: : 其实我根本不喜欢女生。这一切都只是为了看你鸡巴的大阴谋。

lines.en: : Hey, all you need to do is ask.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你开口问就行了嘛。

lines.en: scene rinintheinn35
: In all seriousness, though...thank you...
lines.zh: : 说真的……谢谢你……

lines.en: : This entire time, I’ve been worried that something might happen if I take too long.
lines.zh: : 这段时间，我一直在担心，要是我拖得太久就会出事。

lines.en: : And when I noticed you guys starting to see each other more and more, I couldn’t help but let my mind wander.
lines.zh: : 而且当我发现你们俩见面越来越频繁时，我忍不住就开始胡思乱想。

lines.en: : Did it ever wander to anything {i}interesting?{/i}
lines.zh: : 想过什么{i}有意思{/i}的事吗？

lines.en: scene rinintheinn36
: Wh-what?! Of course not!
lines.zh: : 什……什么？！当然没有！

lines.en: : I mean...maybe once or twice! But most of the time you weren’t there and-
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……也许有一两次！不过大多数时候你都不在场，而且——

lines.en: : Actually, I’m just not even going to talk anymore! K thanks bye!
lines.zh: : 算了，我干脆不说话了！好了谢谢再见！

lines.en: scene rinintheinn37
Rin goes to get off the bed but I pull her closer and she quickly finds a comfortable place against me, playfully slapping my chest with the back of her hand.
lines.zh: Rin要下床，可我把她拉得更近，她很快就在我身上找到了舒服的位置，用手背顽皮地拍了下我的胸口。

lines.en: She laughs like a [young_girl] would with an older brother.
lines.zh: 她笑得像个[young_girl]对着哥哥那样。

lines.en: An older brother consoling his sister after her first breakup.
lines.zh: 像哥哥在妹妹第一次失恋后安慰她那样。

lines.en: Just, in this case, Rin hasn’t been broken up with.
lines.zh: 只不过，Rin还没有被人甩。

lines.en: In fact, the real struggle hasn’t even begun.
lines.zh: 事实上，真正的挣扎还没开始。

lines.en: That doesn't come until later.
lines.zh: 那要等到以后。

lines.en: But if she can find the willpower within her to follow her heart, I have faith that she’ll come out a stronger person in the end.
lines.zh: 不过如果她能在心里找到追随自己内心的意志力，我相信她最终会变得更强大。

lines.en: It’s why I didn’t betray her.
lines.zh: 这就是我没有背叛她的原因。

lines.en: Even though I’m the scum of the Earth, I do believe that there are some relationships worth preserving.
lines.zh: 就算我是人渣中的人渣，我也确实相信有些关系值得守护。

lines.en: This is one of them.
lines.zh: 这段就是其中之一。

lines.en: I can tell by her smile.
lines.zh: 从她的笑容我就看得出来。

lines.en: scene black
Rin winds up falling asleep in my arms.
lines.zh: Rin最后在我的怀里睡着了。

lines.en: Crying truly is exhausting at times.
lines.zh: 哭，有时候真的很累人。

lines.en: I let her rest for around half an hour before deciding to wake her up.
lines.zh: 我让她休息了大概半小时，然后决定把她叫醒。

lines.en: I’m not sure what time she intends to meet up with Chika, but I do know that I shouldn’t let it get too dark before that happens.
lines.zh: 我不确定她打算几点去见Chika，但我知道不该让天黑得太厉害。

lines.en: At the very least, I’d like to go back to the beach and walk around for a bit.
lines.zh: 至少，我想回海滩再走走。

lines.en: I feel like I’ve been cooped up here for quite some time now.
lines.zh: 感觉自己已经在这儿憋了挺久了。

lines.en: Rin wipes the tears from her eyes as she comes to.
lines.zh: Rin醒来时擦掉了眼里的泪水。

lines.en: And before we know it, the two of us are walking shoulder to shoulder down the shoreline.
lines.zh: 不知不觉间，我们两个并肩沿着海岸线走着。

lines.en: But only one of us will likely come back unscathed.
lines.zh: 不过大概只有我们中的一个能毫发无损地回来。
